scenario: The ego vehicle travels along a multi-lane curved road and encounters a stationary motorcycle on the lane center line and a stationary passenger car positioned to the right of the motorcycle near the lane line.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward along the curved road and approaches the stationary vehicles ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The motorcycle remains stationary on the lane center line in the curve.
The passenger car remains stationary to the right of the motorcycle with its left wheels positioned near the lane line.

spatial_relation: On a curved multi-lane road with a 500m radius, the ego vehicle approaches from behind on the left lane, while a stationary motorcycle sits on the lane center line and a stationary passenger car is positioned to the right of the motorcycle with its left wheels 0.2m from the lane line.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario requires a curved road with at least three lanes, a curve radius of 500m, and sufficient curve length for at least 5 seconds of driving; the ego must maintain proper lane positioning while approaching the stationary obstacles.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the green car from first-person perspective; two adversarials are the stationary motorcycle and blue passenger car. 2. Enumeration: adversarials length is 2. 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches on straight section; midpoint enters R500 curve; ending nears stationary motorcycle and car. 4. Evidence: motorcycle stays fixed on center line; passenger car remains stationary to motorcycle's right with 0.2m gap to lane line.
